bashToolPatterns.reason: a nested claude run with --bare loads no hooks, so the guard does not apply to it
a nested claude run with --safe-mode loads no hooks, so the guard does not apply to it
a nested claude run whose --settings sets disableAllHooks loads no hooks, so the guard does not apply to it
a nested claude run whose --setting-sources leaves out the user scope does not load the guard registered there
a nested claude run whose --setting-sources leaves out the project or local scope may not load a guard registered there
a nested claude run with --settings loads settings the engine cannot read, which may remove hooks
a nested claude run with --plugin-dir loads hooks and settings from a directory the engine cannot read
a nested claude run with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR set reads its settings and hooks from another directory
